# Vendored dependencies

- markdown-it 15.0.3: `markdown-it.min.js`, MIT (`markdown-it.LICENSE`).
- markdown-it-task-lists 2.1.1: `task-lists.min.js`, ISC (`task-lists.LICENSE`).
- DOMPurify 3.4.17: `purify.min.js`, Apache-2.0 OR MPL-2.0 (`dompurify.LICENSE`).

Copied unmodified from their published npm packages. All run locally; no CDN is used.
